name: WidgetPilot For Elementor
author: Mohammad Risad

sections.description:
WidgetPilot For Elementor scans every page/post built with Elementor and reports which widgets (core, Elementor Pro, and third-party addon) are actually being used on your site, and which ones are just sitting there unused.

Version 1.0 (Free) features

  • Dashboard: total widgets, used, unused, total addons, pages scanned, last scan time
  • Widget Explorer: source, category, used/unused status, usage count, used-on pages
  • Search & filter: by name, plugin, category, used/unused
  • Sort: by name or usage
  • Reports: most used, least used, unused widgets
  • Manual scan / rescan / refresh cache
  • Settings: clear cache, delete data on uninstall

Additional Information

Data Storage
WidgetPilot For Elementor stores scanned widget data in two custom database tables. No data is sent to any external server — all scanning happens locally on your site.

Performance
Scanning runs only in wp-admin, on demand (Scan Now) or via a daily WP-Cron event. Nothing runs on the front end, so there is no impact on your site’s page load speed.

Compatibility
Detects Elementor core widgets, Elementor Pro widgets, and third-party addon widgets (e.g. Essential Addons, PowerPack, Jet Elements) as long as they register through Elementor’s standard widget system.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the widgetpilot-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Widget Manager in the admin sidebar.
  4. Click Scan Now to run the first scan.
sections.faq:
Does this work without Elementor?

No, Elementor must be installed and active for widget detection to work.

Will this slow down my site?

No. All scanning happens in wp-admin only, on demand or via a daily scheduled scan. Nothing runs on the front end.

Does it delete my data when I uninstall?

Only if you enable “Delete data on uninstall” in Settings. Otherwise your scan history stays in the database in case you reinstall.
